nodes.description: Private address state variable holding the exhibition organizer, set once in the constructor from msg.sender and used as the authorization anchor.
Private address state variable holding the selected winner; written by pickWinner and used as the ether payout destination in transferAmount.
Private bool state variable gating registration, payout and winner-name readout; set to true inside pickWinner.
Private mapping(address => Participant) storing name/phone/email records keyed by participant address.
Private address[] array of all registered participant addresses; its length drives the winner index computation.
Constructor that sets organizer = msg.sender, establishing the privileged role at deployment time.
Payable public registration function: charges an entry fee, writes the caller's Participant record, appends the caller to participantList and forwards the fee to the organizer.
Organizer-only function that computes a pseudo-random index, assigns winnerAddress from participantList and flips isWinnerSelected.
Payable organizer-only function that forwards ether to winnerAddress once a winner has been selected.
View getter returning the isWinnerSelected flag.
View getter returning the full participantList array.
View getter returning the winner's name from participants[winnerAddress], guarded by isWinnerSelected.
View getter returning the organizer address.
Private helper performing the actual ether value transfer to a target account.
Private view function producing a pseudo-random number from keccak256(block.difficulty, now, participantList).
Caller-controlled address used as owner, mapping key, array element and authorization subject throughout the contract.
Block timestamp (now) consumed by random(), making the winner selection miner-influenceable.
External ether value transfer _account.transfer(_amount) executed inside sendAmount.
Predictable randomness construction keccak256(block.difficulty, now, participantList) used to pick the winner.
Registration parameter holding the participant name string.
Registration parameter holding the participant phone string.
Registration parameter holding the participant email string.
sendAmount parameter carrying the wei amount to transfer.
sendAmount parameter carrying the recipient address of the transfer.
Storage pointer local aliasing participants[msg.sender] inside registration.
Local uint index computed as random() % participantList.length inside pickWinner.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the untrusted msg.sender to organizer, creating the single privileged role of the contract.
Registration parameter _name is written into the caller's Participant record.
Registration parameter _phone is written into the caller's Participant record.
Registration parameter _email is written into the caller's Participant record.
The storage pointer participant is derived from participants[msg.sender], an untrusted caller-controlled mapping key.
Writes through the participant storage pointer mutate the participants mapping.
participantList.push(msg.sender) lets any untrusted caller append to and grow the participant array.
registration calls sendAmount(msg.value, organizer) to forward the entry fee.
registration updates the participants mapping state.
registration updates the participantList array state.
pickWinner enforces require(msg.sender == organizer), so the untrusted caller must equal the privileged organizer.
pickWinner reads the organizer state variable for its authorization check.
Local index is computed with participantList.length as the modulo bound.
The value returned by random() determines the winner index in pickWinner.
block.timestamp (now) is fed into random(), giving miners influence over the outcome.
random() builds its entropy from block.difficulty and block.timestamp, a predictable unsafe randomness source.
block.timestamp is an operand of the unsafe keccak256 randomness construction.
winnerAddress is assigned from participantList[index] using the locally computed index.
pickWinner writes the selected winner into winnerAddress.
pickWinner sets isWinnerSelected to true after choosing a winner.
transferAmount gates payout on require(msg.sender == organizer), making the untrusted caller part of the authorization path.
transferAmount reads the organizer state variable for its authorization check.
transferAmount requires isWinnerSelected to be true before paying out.
winnerAddress is read as the payout destination in transferAmount.
transferAmount delegates the actual payment to sendAmount(msg.value, winnerAddress).
The _amount parameter determines the wei value moved by the external transfer.
The _account parameter is the recipient of the external transfer operation.
sendAmount executes the external value transfer _account.transfer(_amount).
The external ether transfer performed by sendAmount hands control to the recipient on the transferAmount payout path.
getWinner requires isWinnerSelected before revealing the winner name.
getWinner reads winnerAddress to index the participants mapping.
getWinner returns participants[winnerAddress].name from the participants mapping.
getIsWinnerSelected returns the isWinnerSelected state variable.
getParticipants returns the participantList array state.
getOrganizer returns the organizer state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: _name is a local registration parameter that only serves as input to the registration function and carries no independent security semantics.
_phone is a local registration parameter consumed only by the registration function.
_email is a local registration parameter consumed only by the registration function.
_amount is a parameter of the private sendAmount helper and directly feeds the unsafe transfer operation.
_account is a parameter of the private sendAmount helper and directly supplies the transfer recipient.
participant is a storage pointer local created inside registration to write the caller's record.
index is a computed local within pickWinner used to select the winner address.
